224	/**
225	 * Main function to create generation from completed task
226	 *
227	 * PARAMS-DRIVEN ROUTING - all 6 cases in one place:
228	 * 1. Regeneration: existing generation for this task → add variant
229	 * 2. Variant on source: based_on present → variant on that generation
230	 * 3. Variant on child: child_generation_id present → variant on existing child
231	 * 4. Stitch task: travel_stitch/join_final_stitch → variant on parent
232	 * 5. Child generation: parent_generation_id present → child under parent
233	 * 6. Standalone: neither → independent generation
234	 *
235	 * Single-item detection: is_single_item param OR (is_first_segment && is_last_segment)
236	 * Child order: child_order OR segment_index OR join_index
237	 */
238	export async function createGenerationFromTask(
239	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
240	  taskId: string,
241	  taskData: unknown,
242	  publicUrl: string,
243	  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
244	  logger?: CompletionLogger,
245	  authContext: CompletionAuthContext,
246	): Promise<GenerationCreationOutcome> {
247	  assertCompletionAuthContext(authContext, 'createGenerationFromTask');
248	
249	  const normalizedTaskData = normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData);
250	  const skipReason = getGenerationSkipReason(normalizedTaskData);
251	  if (skipReason) {
252	    return { status: 'skipped', reason: skipReason };
253	  }
254	
255	  const routeParams = resolveGenerationRouteParams(normalizedTaskData);
256	
257	  logger?.debug("Generation routing", {
258	    task_id: taskId,
259	    based_on: routeParams.basedOn,
260	    child_generation_id: routeParams.childGenerationId,
261	    parent_generation_id: routeParams.parentGenerationId,
262	    child_order: routeParams.childOrder,
263	    is_single_item: routeParams.isSingleItem,
264	    is_stitch_task: routeParams.isStitchTask,
265	  });
266	
267	  try {
268	    const existingGenerationRaw = await findExistingGeneration(supabase, taskId);
269	    const existingGeneration = toGenerationRef(existingGenerationRaw);
270	    if (existingGenerationRaw && !existingGeneration) {
271	      throw new CompletionError({
272	        code: 'generation_existing_shape_invalid',
273	        context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
274	        recoverable: false,
275	        message: `Existing generation lookup returned an invalid shape for task ${taskId}`,
276	        metadata: { task_id: taskId },
277	      });
278	    }
279	
280	    if (existingGeneration) {
281	      const completionAsset = await handleRegeneration(
282	        supabase,
283	        taskId,
284	        normalizedTaskData,
285	        existingGeneration,
286	        publicUrl,
287	        thumbnailUrl,
288	        logger,
289	      );
290	      return {
291	        status: 'created',
292	        generation: existingGeneration,
293	        completionAsset,
294	      };
295	    }
296	
297	    if (routeParams.basedOn && !routeParams.createAsGeneration) {
298	      const completionAsset = await handleVariantCreation(
299	        supabase,
300	        taskId,
301	        normalizedTaskData,
302	        routeParams.basedOn,
303	        publicUrl,
304	        thumbnailUrl,
305	      );
306	      if (completionAsset) {
307	        return {
308	          status: 'created',
309	          generation: { id: routeParams.basedOn },
310	          completionAsset,
311	        };
312	      }
313	    }
314	
315	    const handlerContext: GenerationHandlerContext = {
316	      supabase,
317	      taskId,
318	      taskData: normalizedTaskData,
319	      publicUrl,
320	      thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl || null,
321	      logger,
322	      childGenerationId: routeParams.childGenerationId ?? undefined,
323	      parentGenerationId: routeParams.parentGenerationId ?? undefined,
324	      childOrder: routeParams.childOrder,
325	      isSingleItem: routeParams.isSingleItem,
326	    };
327	
328	    for (const attempt of classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams)) {
329	      const routeResult = await executeGenerationRouteAttempt(attempt, handlerContext);
330	      if (routeResult) {
331	        return { status: 'created', ...routeResult };
332	      }
333	    }
334	
335	    throw new CompletionError({
336	      code: 'generation_route_no_result',
337	      context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
338	      recoverable: false,
339	      message: `No generation route produced a result for task ${taskId}`,
340	      metadata: {
341	        task_id: taskId,
342	        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
343	        route_attempts: classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams),
344	      },
345	    });
346	
347	  } catch (error) {
348	    const normalizedError = toCompletionError(error, {
349	      code: 'generation_completion_failed',
350	      context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
351	      recoverable: true,
352	      message: `Failed to create generation for task ${taskId}`,
353	      metadata: {
354	        task_id: taskId,
355	        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
356	      },
357	    });
358	    logger?.error("Error creating generation", {
359	      task_id: taskId,
360	      error: normalizedError.message,
361	      error_code: normalizedError.code,
362	      recoverable: normalizedError.recoverable,
363	      error_context: normalizedError.context,
364	      error_metadata: normalizedError.metadata,
365	    });
366	    throw normalizedError;
367	  }
368	}
369	
370	/**
371	 * Handle regeneration case - task already has a generation, create new variant
372	 */
373	async function handleRegeneration(
374	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
375	  taskId: string,
376	  taskData: CompletedTaskData,
377	  existingGeneration: GenerationRef,
378	  publicUrl: string,
379	  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
380	  logger?: CompletionLogger
381	): Promise<CompletionAssetRef> {
382	  logger?.info("Existing generation found - creating regenerated variant", {
383	    task_id: taskId,
384	    existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
385	    action: "create_regenerated_variant"
386	  });
387	
388	  const variantParams = {
389	    ...taskData.params,
390	    source_task_id: taskId,
391	    created_from: 'task_completion',
392	    tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
393	  };
394	
395	  const variant = await createVariant(
396	    supabase,
397	    existingGeneration.id,
398	    publicUrl,
399	    thumbnailUrl || null,
400	    variantParams,
401	    true,
402	    'regenerated',
403	    null
404	  );
405	
406	  const { shotId, addInPosition } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
407	  if (shotId) {
408	    await linkGenerationToShot(supabase, shotId, existingGeneration.id, addInPosition);
409	  }
410	
411	  const { error: markGenerationCreatedError } = await supabase
412	    .from('tasks')
413	    .update({ generation_created: true })
414	    .eq('id', taskId);
415	
416	  if (markGenerationCreatedError) {
417	    throw new CompletionError({
418	      code: 'regeneration_generation_created_update_failed',
419	      context: 'handleRegeneration',
420	      recoverable: true,
421	      message: `Failed to persist generation_created marker for task ${taskId}`,
422	      metadata: {
423	        task_id: taskId,
424	        existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
425	      },
426	      cause: markGenerationCreatedError,
427	    });
428	  }
429	
430	  return {
431	    generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
432	    variant_id: variant.id,
433	    location: publicUrl,
434	    ...(thumbnailUrl ? { thumbnail_url: thumbnailUrl } : {}),
435	    media_type: resolveMediaType(taskData.content_type, publicUrl),
436	    created_as: 'variant',
437	  };
438	}

448	  const newGeneration = await insertGeneration(supabase, generationRecord);

165	// Note: (parent_generation_id, child_order) and (parent_generation_id, pair_shot_generation_id)
166	// are NOT unique - duplicates can arise from retries/re-runs. child_order is intra-run only;
167	// pair_shot_generation_id is the durable position key. We use order(created_at DESC)+limit(1)
168	// to deterministically pick the most recent row.
169	export async function findExistingGenerationAtPosition(
170	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
171	  parentGenerationId: string,
172	  childOrder: number,
173	  pairShotGenId?: string
174	): Promise<string | null> {
175	
176	  if (pairShotGenId) {
177	    const { data: matchByColumn, error: matchByColumnError } = await supabase
178	      .from('generations')
179	      .select('id')
180	      .eq('parent_generation_id', parentGenerationId)
181	      .eq('is_child', true)
182	      .eq('pair_shot_generation_id', pairShotGenId)
183	      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
184	      .limit(1)
185	      .maybeSingle();
186	
187	    if (!matchByColumnError && matchByColumn?.id) {
188	      return matchByColumn.id;
189	    }
190	
191	  }
192	
193	  if (!pairShotGenId) {
194	    const { data: matchByChildOrder, error: matchByChildOrderError } = await supabase
195	      .from('generations')
196	      .select('id')
197	      .eq('parent_generation_id', parentGenerationId)
198	      .eq('is_child', true)
199	      .eq('child_order', childOrder)
200	      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
201	      .limit(1)
202	      .maybeSingle();
203	
204	    if (!matchByChildOrderError && matchByChildOrder?.id) {
205	      return matchByChildOrder.id;
206	    }
207	  }
208	
209	  return null;
210	}

212	export async function createChildGenerationRecord(

218	): Promise<unknown> {
219	  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, logger } = ctx;
220	  const params = asRecord(taskData.params);

226	    params, toolType, generationType, shotId, thumbnailUrl || undefined, taskId
227	  );
228	
229	  if (pairShotGenerationId && !generationParams.pair_shot_generation_id) {
230	    generationParams = { ...generationParams, pair_shot_generation_id: pairShotGenerationId };
231	  }
232

234	    supabase,
235	    generationParams,
236	    parentGenerationId,
237	    childOrder,
238	  );
239	  if (predecessorVariantId) {
240	    generationParams = {
241	      ...generationParams,
242	      continuation_predecessor_variant_id: predecessorVariantId,
243	    };
244	  }
245	
246	  const newGenerationId = crypto.randomUUID();
247	
248	  const generationName = asString(params.generation_name);
249	
250	  // Find based_on
251	  const basedOnGenerationId = await resolveBasedOn(supabase, params);
252	
253	  logger?.info("Creating child generation record", {
254	    task_id: taskId,
255	    generation_id: newGenerationId,
256	    parent_generation_id: parentGenerationId,
257	    child_order: childOrder,
258	    is_single_item: isSingleItemCase,
259	    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
260	    pair_shot_generation_id: pairShotGenerationId || null,
261	  });
262	
263	  // Verify pair_shot_generation_id still exists before inserting (FK constraint check)
264	  // If the shot_generation was deleted between task creation and completion, set to NULL
265	  let validatedPairShotGenId = pairShotGenerationId || null;
266	  if (validatedPairShotGenId) {
267	    let shotGenQuery = supabase
268	      .from('shot_generations')
269	      .select('id')
270	      .eq('id', validatedPairShotGenId);
271	
272	    // Scope to current shot to avoid matching a generation in a different shot
273	    if (shotId) {
274	      shotGenQuery = shotGenQuery.eq('shot_id', shotId);
275	    }
276	
277	    const { data: shotGenExists } = await shotGenQuery.maybeSingle();
278	
279	    if (!shotGenExists) {
280	      validatedPairShotGenId = null;
281	    }
282	  }
283	
284	  const generationRecord: Record<string, unknown> = {
285	    id: newGenerationId,
286	    tasks: [taskId],
287	    params: generationParams,
288	    type: generationType,
289	    project_id: taskData.project_id,
290	    name: generationName,
291	    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
292	    parent_generation_id: parentGenerationId,
293	    is_child: true,
294	    child_order: childOrder,
295	    // Store pair_shot_generation_id as proper column (not just in params)
296	    // This enables FK constraint and ON DELETE SET NULL behavior
297	    // Validated above to prevent FK violation if shot_generation was deleted
298	    pair_shot_generation_id: validatedPairShotGenId,
299	    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
300	  };
301	
302	  const newGeneration = await insertGeneration(supabase, generationRecord);
303	
304	  // Build diagnostic snapshot for segment tasks without mixing it into write-path orchestration.
305	  const isTravelSegmentTask = taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.TRAVEL_SEGMENT ||
306	                               taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.INDIVIDUAL_TRAVEL_SEGMENT;
307	  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
308	
309	  if (isTravelSegmentTask && childOrder !== null) {
310	    try {
311	      const segmentSnapshot = buildSegmentMasterStateSnapshot({

313	        generationId: newGeneration.id,

317	        segmentParams: params,

327	      });

329	  }
330	
331	  // Create "original" variant
332	  let autoViewedAt: string | null = null;
333	  let createdFrom = 'child_generation_original';
334	
335	  if (isSingleItemCase) {
336	    autoViewedAt = new Date().toISOString();

2	 * Parent generation handling

5	
6	import type { SupabaseClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.49.4';
7	import { extractShotAndPosition } from './params.ts';

15	
16	/**
17	 * Resolve a canonical parent generation for orchestrator-derived tasks.
18	 * Never creates ad-hoc placeholder generations.
19	 */
20	export async function getOrCreateParentGeneration(
21	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
22	  orchestratorTaskId: string,
23	  projectId: string,
24	  segmentParams?: unknown
25	): Promise<unknown> {
26	  try {
27	    // Check if orchestrator already specifies a parent_generation_id
28	    let orchTask: { task_type?: string; params?: unknown } | null = null;
29	    try {
30	      const { data } = await supabase
31	        .from('tasks')
32	        .select('task_type, params')
33	        .eq('id', orchestratorTaskId)
34	        .single();
35	      orchTask = data;
36	    } catch {
37	      // Best-effort lookup: continue with segmentParams fallback if task fetch fails.
38	    }
39	
40	    // Check for parent_generation_id in orchestrator params
41	    const orchestrationContract = (
42	      orchTask?.params?.orchestration_contract && typeof orchTask.params.orchestration_contract === 'object'
43	        ? orchTask.params.orchestration_contract
44	        : null
45	    ) as Record<string, unknown> | null;
46	
47	    const parentGenId = orchestrationContract?.parent_generation_id ||
48	                        orchTask?.params?.parent_generation_id ||
49	                        orchTask?.params?.orchestrator_details?.parent_generation_id ||
50	                        segmentParams?.orchestration_contract?.parent_generation_id ||
51	                        segmentParams?.full_orchestrator_payload?.parent_generation_id;
52	
53	    if (parentGenId) {
54	      const { data: existingParent, error: parentError } = await supabase
55	        .from('generations')
56	        .select('*')
57	        .eq('id', parentGenId)
58	        .single();
59	
60	      if (existingParent && !parentError) {
61	        return existingParent;
62	      }
63	
64	      throw new CompletionError({
65	        code: 'parent_generation_lookup_failed',
66	        context: 'getOrCreateParentGeneration',
67	        recoverable: false,
68	        message: `Parent generation ${String(parentGenId)} could not be loaded`,
69	        metadata: {
70	          orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
71	          parent_generation_id: String(parentGenId),
72	        },
73	        cause: parentError,
74	      });
75	    }
76	
77	    // Try to find existing generation for this orchestrator task
78	    const existing = await findExistingGeneration(supabase, orchestratorTaskId);
79	    if (existing) {
80	      return existing;
81	    }
82	
83	    // Fall back to the canonical shot parent for legacy tasks that might be missing parent_generation_id.
84	    const paramsForShotExtraction = orchTask?.params || segmentParams;
85	    if (paramsForShotExtraction) {
86	      const { shotId } = extractShotAndPosition(paramsForShotExtraction);
87	      if (shotId) {
88	        const { data: ensuredParentId, error: ensureError } = await supabase
89	          .rpc('ensure_shot_parent_generation', {
90	            p_shot_id: shotId,
91	            p_project_id: projectId,
92	          });
93	
94	        if (ensureError || !ensuredParentId) {
95	          throw new CompletionError({
96	            code: 'parent_generation_ensure_failed',
97	            context: 'getOrCreateParentGeneration',
98	            recoverable: true,
99	            message: `Failed to ensure canonical parent generation for shot ${shotId}`,
100	            metadata: {
101	              orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
102	              shot_id: shotId,
103	              project_id: projectId,
104	            },
105	            cause: ensureError,
106	          });
107	        }
108	
109	        const { data: ensuredParent, error: parentFetchError } = await supabase
110	          .from('generations')
111	          .select('*')
112	          .eq('id', ensuredParentId)
113	          .single();
114	
115	        if (parentFetchError || !ensuredParent) {
116	          throw new CompletionError({
117	            code: 'parent_generation_lookup_failed',
118	            context: 'getOrCreateParentGeneration',
119	            recoverable: false,
120	            message: `Canonical parent generation ${String(ensuredParentId)} could not be loaded`,
121	            metadata: {
122	              orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
123	              parent_generation_id: String(ensuredParentId),
124	            },
125	            cause: parentFetchError,
126	          });
127	        }
128	
129	        return ensuredParent;
130	      }
131	    }
132	
133	    return null;
134	
135	  } catch (error) {
136	    throw toCompletionError(error, {
137	      code: 'parent_generation_resolution_failed',
138	      context: 'getOrCreateParentGeneration',
139	      recoverable: true,
140	      message: `Failed to resolve parent generation for orchestrator task ${orchestratorTaskId}`,
141	      metadata: {
142	        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
143	        project_id: projectId,
144	      },
145	    });
146	  }
147	}

189	      ...taskData.params,
190	      source_task_id: taskId,
191	      ...extraParams,
192	    };

194	    const variant = await createVariant(
195	      supabase,

232	/**
233	 * Determines the viewedAt timestamp for a child generation variant.
234	 * For single-segment cases (only one child under parent), returns current timestamp.
235	 * For multi-segment cases, returns null.
236	 *
237	 * This centralizes the single-segment detection logic that was previously scattered
238	 * across three different code paths:
239	 * 1. individual_travel_segment with child_generation_id (SPECIAL CASE 1a)
240	 * 2. Travel segment matching existing generation at position
241	 * 3. Standard child generation creation
242	 *
243	 * @param supabase - Supabase client
244	 * @param options - Detection options (check in order of preference)
245	 * @returns ISO timestamp string if single-segment, null otherwise
246	 */
247	export async function getChildVariantViewedAt(
248	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
249	  options: {
250	    // Check 1: Explicit flag from orchestrator detection (fastest)
251	    taskParams?: { _isSingleSegmentCase?: boolean };
252	    // Check 2: Count siblings under parent (slower but works for individual segments)
253	    childGeneration?: { parent_generation_id: string | null; is_child: boolean };
254	    parentGenerationId?: string;
255	  }
256	): Promise<string | null> {
257	  // Fast path: Check explicit flag first (set during orchestrator detection)
258	  if (options.taskParams?._isSingleSegmentCase === true) {
259	    return new Date().toISOString();
260	  }
261	
262	  // Slow path: Count siblings to determine if single-segment
263	  // Used by individual_travel_segment which doesn't go through orchestrator detection
264	  const parentId = options.childGeneration?.parent_generation_id || options.parentGenerationId;
265	  // Only count if: (a) we have a parentId from childGeneration with is_child=true, or (b) we have explicit parentGenerationId
266	  const shouldCountSiblings = parentId && (
267	    options.childGeneration?.is_child === true ||  // childGeneration explicitly marked as child
268	    (!options.childGeneration && options.parentGenerationId)  // or explicit parentGenerationId without childGeneration
269	  );
270	  if (shouldCountSiblings) {
271	    try {
272	      const { count } = await supabase
273	        .from('generations')
274	        .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
275	        .eq('parent_generation_id', parentId)
276	        .eq('is_child', true);
277	
278	      if (count === 1) {
279	        return new Date().toISOString();
280	      }
281	    } catch {
282	      // Non-blocking: if sibling counting fails, treat as non-single-segment.
283	    }
284	  }
285	
286	  return null;
287	}

312	 * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
313	 */
314	async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
315	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
316	  finalStepType: string,
317	  projectId: string,
318	  orchestratorTaskId: string,
319	  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
320	): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
321	  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
322	  if (orchestratorRunId) {
323	    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
324	      supabase,
325	      taskType: finalStepType,
326	      projectId,
327	      select: "id, status",
328	      runId: orchestratorRunId,
329	      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
330	    });
331	  }
332	  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
333	    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
334	      supabase,
335	      taskType: finalStepType,
336	      projectId,
337	      select: "id, status",
338	      orchestratorTaskId,
339	      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
340	    });
341	  }
342	  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
343	    return 'not_found';
344	  }
345	  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
346	    return 'failed';
347	  }
348	  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE)) {
349	    return 'complete';
350	  }
351	  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.QUEUED || task.status === TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS)) {
352	    return 'pending';
353	  }
354	  return 'unknown';
355	}

404	async function markOrchestratorComplete(
405	  params: {
406	    supabase: SupabaseClient;
407	    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
408	    orchestratorTaskId: string;
409	    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
410	    publicUrl: string;
411	    isFinalStep: boolean;
412	    supabaseUrl: string;

414	    logger?: CompletionLogger;
415	  },
416	): Promise<void> {
417	  const {
418	    supabase,
419	    orchestratorTask,
420	    orchestratorTaskId,
421	    allSegments,
422	    publicUrl,
423	    isFinalStep,
424	    supabaseUrl,
425	    serviceKey,
426	    logger,
427	  } = params;
428	  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
429	  for (const segment of allSegments) {
430	    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
431	      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
432	        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
433	      }
434	    }
435	  }
436	  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
437	    status: TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE,
438	    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
439	    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
440	  };
441	  if (isFinalStep) {
442	    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
443	  }
444	  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
445	    .from("tasks")
446	    .update(updateData)
447	    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
448	    .in("status", [...TASK_PROCESSING_STATUSES])
449	    .select('id');
450	  if (updateOrchError) {
451	    throw new CompletionError({

453	      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
454	      recoverable: true,
455	      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
456	      metadata: {
457	        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
458	        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
459	          ? updateOrchError.message
460	          : String(updateOrchError),
461	      },
462	      cause: updateOrchError,
463	    });
464	  }
465	  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
466	  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
467	    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
468	      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
469	    });
470	    return;
471	  }
472	  const billingResult = await tryTriggerCostCalculation({
473	    supabaseUrl,
474	    serviceKey,
475	    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
476	    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
477	  });
478	  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
479	  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
480	  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
481	  await persistBillingOutcome(
482	    supabase,
483	    orchestratorTaskId,
484	    existingResultData,
485	    billingOutcome,
486	    billingDecision,
487	    logger,
488	  );
489	  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
490	    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
491	      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
492	      billing_decision: billingDecision,
493	      billing_result: billingResult,
494	    });
495	  }

41	  hasFinalOutput: boolean;
42	  segmentSlots: SegmentSlot[];
43	  segments: GenerationRow[];
44	  segmentProgress: { completed: number; total: number };
45	  expectedSegmentData: ExpectedSegmentData | null;
46	  isLoading: boolean;
47	  isRefetching: boolean;
48	  refetch: () => void;
49	}

51	function derivePreloadedParentGenerations(
52	  preloadedGenerations?: GenerationRow[],
53	): GenerationRow[] | undefined {
54	  if (!preloadedGenerations) {
55	    return undefined;
56	  }
57	
58	  const parentIds = new Set<string>();
59	  preloadedGenerations.forEach((generation) => {
60	    if (generation.parent_generation_id) {
61	      parentIds.add(generation.parent_generation_id);
62	    }
63	  });
64	
65	  const parents = preloadedGenerations.filter((generation) => {
66	    const isVideo = generation.type?.includes('video');
67	    const isNotChild = !generation.parent_generation_id;
68	    const hasOrchestratorDetails = !!(
69	      generation.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
70	    )?.orchestrator_details;
71	    const generationId = getGenerationId(generation);
72	    const hasChildren = typeof generationId === 'string' && parentIds.has(generationId);
73	
74	    return isVideo && isNotChild && (hasOrchestratorDetails || hasChildren);
75	  });
76	
77	  parents.sort(compareByCreatedAtDesc);
78	
79	  return parents;
80	}
81	
82	function derivePreloadedChildren(
83	  preloadedGenerations: GenerationRow[] | undefined,
84	  selectedParentId: string | null,
85	  parentGenerations: GenerationRow[],
86	): GenerationRow[] | undefined {
87	  if (!preloadedGenerations || !selectedParentId) {
88	    return undefined;
89	  }
90	
91	  const selectedParent = parentGenerations.find(
92	    (parent) => parent.id === selectedParentId || parent.generation_id === selectedParentId,
93	  );
94	  const parentGenerationId = selectedParent?.generation_id || selectedParentId;
95	
96	  return preloadedGenerations.filter((generation) => {
97	    const parentId = generation.parent_generation_id;
98	    return parentId === parentGenerationId || parentId === selectedParentId;
99	  });
100	}
101	
102	function derivePreloadedTimelineData(
103	  preloadedGenerations?: GenerationRow[],
104	): LiveTimelineRow[] | undefined {
105	  if (!preloadedGenerations) {
106	    return undefined;
107	  }
108	
109	  return preloadedGenerations
110	    .filter((generation) => (
111	      generation.timeline_frame !== null
112	      && generation.timeline_frame !== undefined
113	      && generation.timeline_frame >= 0
114	    ))
115	    .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0))
116	    .map((generation) => ({
117	      id: generation.id,
118	      generation_id: generation.generation_id,
119	      timeline_frame: generation.timeline_frame,
120	    }));
121	}
122	
123	function buildPositionMap(timelineData: LiveTimelineRow[] | undefined): Map<string, number> {
124	  const map = new Map<string, number>();
125	  (timelineData || []).forEach((timelineItem, index) => {
126	    map.set(timelineItem.id, index);
127	  });
128	  return map;
129	}

131	export function useSegmentOutputsForShot(
132	  shotId: string | null,
133	  projectId: string | null,
134	  localShotGenPositions?: Map<string, number>,
135	  controlledSelectedParentId?: string | null,
136	  onSelectedParentChange?: (id: string | null) => void,
137	  preloadedGenerations?: GenerationRow[],
138	  trailingShotGenId?: string,
139	): UseSegmentOutputsReturn {
140	  const [internalSelectedParentId, setInternalSelectedParentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
141	
142	  const isControlled = controlledSelectedParentId !== undefined;
143	  const selectedParentId = isControlled ? controlledSelectedParentId : internalSelectedParentId;
144	  const setSelectedParentId = useCallback((id: string | null) => {
145	    if (isControlled && onSelectedParentChange) {
146	      onSelectedParentChange(id);
147	      return;
148	    }
149	    setInternalSelectedParentId(id);
150	  }, [isControlled, onSelectedParentChange]);
151	
152	  const preloadedParentGenerations = useMemo(

154	    [preloadedGenerations],

156

158	    () => buildParentGenerationsQueryKey(shotId!, projectId),
159	    [projectId, shotId],

161

163	    data: parentGenerationsData,
164	    isLoading: isLoadingParents,
165	    isFetching: isFetchingParents,
166	    refetch: refetchParents,
167	  } = useQuery({
168	    queryKey: parentQueryKey,
169	    queryFn: async () => {
170	      if (!shotId || !projectId) {
171	        return [];
172	      }
173	      return fetchParentGenerations(shotId, projectId);
174	    },

178

181	    [preloadedParentGenerations, parentGenerationsData],

183	
184	  useEffect(() => {
185	    if (!shotId || isControlled) {
186	      return;
187	    }
188	
189	    if (parentGenerations.length > 0 && !selectedParentId) {
190	      setSelectedParentId(parentGenerations[0].id);
191	      return;
192	    }
193	
194	    if (parentGenerations.length > 0 && selectedParentId) {

196	      if (!selectionExists) {

199	    }
200	  }, [isControlled, parentGenerations, selectedParentId, setSelectedParentId, shotId]);
201	
202	  const selectedParent = useMemo(() => {

205	    }

207	  }, [parentGenerations, selectedParentId]);
208	
209	  const preloadedChildren = useMemo(

226	    [REDACTED],

228	      if (!selectedParentId) {
229	        return [];
230	      }
231	      return fetchChildGenerations(selectedParentId);
232	    },
233	    enabled: !!selectedParentId && !preloadedGenerations,
234	    ...childrenPollingConfig,

236	  });
237	
238	  const childGenerations = useMemo(
239	    () => (preloadedChildren ?? childGenerationsData) || [],

242	
243	  const segments = useMemo(
244	    () => childGenerations.filter((child) => isSegmentGeneration(child.params as Record<string, unknown> | null)),
245	    [childGenerations],

247	
248	  const preloadedTimelineData = useMemo(
249	    () => derivePreloadedTimelineData(preloadedGenerations),
250	    [preloadedGenerations],
251	  );
252	
253	  const liveTimelineQueryKey = useMemo(
254	    () => buildLiveTimelineQueryKey(shotId!),
255	    [shotId],
256	  );
257	
258	  const {
259	    data: liveTimelineData,
260	    refetch: refetchTimeline,
261	  } = useQuery({

263	    queryFn: async () => {
264	      if (!shotId) {

266	      }
267	      return fetchLiveTimeline(shotId);
268	    },
269	    enabled: !!shotId && !preloadedGenerations,

272	
273	  const effectiveTimelineData = preloadedTimelineData ?? liveTimelineData;
274	
275	  const liveShotGenIdToPosition = useMemo(

295	    effectiveTimelineData,

303	  const segmentProgress = useMemo(() => {

308	  const refetch = useCallback(() => {

313	
314	  return {

325	    isRefetching: isFetchingParents || isFetchingChildren,
326	    refetch,

328	}

5	export function coerceRawGenerationDbRow(value: unknown): RawGenerationDbRow | null {
6	  const record = asRecord(value);
7	  if (!record || typeof record.id !== 'string') {
8	    return null;
9	  }
10	
11	  return {
12	    id: record.id,
13	    ...(asNullableString(record.location) !== undefined ? { location: asNullableString(record.location) } : {}),
14	    ...(asNullableString(record.thumbnail_url) !== undefined ? { thumbnail_url: asNullableString(record.thumbnail_url) } : {}),
15	    ...(asNullableString(record.type) !== undefined ? { type: asNullableString(record.type) } : {}),
16	    ...(typeof record.created_at === 'string' ? { created_at: record.created_at } : {}),
17	    ...(asNullableString(record.updated_at) !== undefined ? { updated_at: asNullableString(record.updated_at) } : {}),
18	    ...(asRecord(record.params) || record.params === null ? { params: (asRecord(record.params) ?? null) } : {}),
19	    ...(asNullableString(record.parent_generation_id) !== undefined ? { parent_generation_id: asNullableString(record.parent_generation_id) } : {}),
20	    ...(asNullableNumber(record.child_order) !== undefined ? { child_order: asNullableNumber(record.child_order) } : {}),
21	    ...(typeof record.starred === 'boolean' ? { starred: record.starred } : {}),
22	    ...(asNullableString(record.pair_shot_generation_id) !== undefined ? { pair_shot_generation_id: asNullableString(record.pair_shot_generation_id) } : {}),
23	    ...(asNullableString(record.primary_variant_id) !== undefined ? { primary_variant_id: asNullableString(record.primary_variant_id) } : {}),

27	export function coerceRawGenerationDbRows(value: unknown): RawGenerationDbRow[] {
28	  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
29	    return [];
30	  }
31	
32	  return value.map((entry, index) => {
33	    const row = coerceRawGenerationDbRow(entry);
34	    if (!row) {
35	      throw new Error(`Invalid generation row at index ${index}`);
36	    }
37	    return row;
38	  });
39	}

53	        retryRecommended: false,

68	    };

125	  const resolveFromCandidate = (
126	    value: unknown,
127	    source: string,
128	  ): ExpectedSegmentCountResolution | null => {
129	    const parsed = parseNonNegativeIntCandidate(value);
130	    if (parsed.invalid) {
131	      return {
132	        value: null,
133	        invalid: true,
134	        source,
135	        raw: value,
136	      };
137	    }
138	    if (parsed.value !== null) {
139	      return {
140	        value: parsed.value,
141	        invalid: false,
142	        source,
143	        raw: value,
144	      };
145	    }
146	    return null;
147	  };
148	
149	  if (
150	    taskType === TASK_TYPES.TRAVEL_SEGMENT
151	    || taskType === TASK_TYPES.INDIVIDUAL_TRAVEL_SEGMENT
152	  ) {
153	    return (
154	      resolveFromCandidate(
155	        orchestratorDetails.num_new_segments_to_generate,
156	        'orchestrator_details.num_new_segments_to_generate',
157	      )
158	      || resolveFromCandidate(
159	        orchestratorParams.num_new_segments_to_generate,
160	        'num_new_segments_to_generate',
161	      )
162	      || { value: null, invalid: false }
163	    );
164	  }
165	
166	  if (taskType === TASK_TYPES.JOIN_CLIPS_SEGMENT) {
167	    const clipList = orchestratorDetails.clip_list;
168	    if (Array.isArray(clipList) && clipList.length > 1) {
169	      return {
170	        value: clipList.length - 1,
171	        invalid: false,
172	        source: 'orchestrator_details.clip_list',
173	        raw: clipList.length,
174	      };
175	    }
176	    return (
177	      resolveFromCandidate(
178	        orchestratorDetails.num_joins,
179	        'orchestrator_details.num_joins',
180	      )
181	      || { value: null, invalid: false }
182	    );
183	  }
184	
185	  return { value: null, invalid: false };
186	}

188	export function summarizeSegmentCompletion(
189	  allSegments: SegmentTaskStatus[],
190	): SegmentCompletionStats {
191	  const foundSegments = allSegments.length;
192	  const completedSegments = allSegments.filter((segment) => segment.status === 'Complete').length;
193	  const failedSegments = allSegments.filter((segment) => isFailureStatus(segment.status)).length;
194	  const pendingSegments = foundSegments - completedSegments - failedSegments;
195	
196	  return {
197	    foundSegments,
198	    completedSegments,
199	    failedSegments,
200	    pendingSegments,
201	  };
202	}
203	
204	export function evaluateSegmentCompletionGate(
205	  expectedSegmentCount: number | null,
206	  stats: SegmentCompletionStats,
207	): SegmentCompletionGate {
208	  if (stats.foundSegments === 0) {
209	    return { kind: 'wait', reason: 'no_segments' };
210	  }
211	
212	  if (stats.pendingSegments > 0) {
213	    return { kind: 'wait', reason: 'segments_pending' };
214	  }
215	
216	  if (stats.failedSegments > 0) {
217	    return {
218	      kind: 'fail',
219	      reason: 'segments_failed',
220	      failedSegments: stats.failedSegments,
221	      foundSegments: stats.foundSegments,
222	    };
223	  }
224	
225	  if (expectedSegmentCount !== null && stats.foundSegments < expectedSegmentCount) {
226	    return {
227	      kind: 'fail',
228	      reason: 'missing_segments',
229	      expectedSegments: expectedSegmentCount,
230	      foundSegments: stats.foundSegments,
231	    };
232	  }
233	
234	  return { kind: 'ready' };
235	}

69	export async function markTaskFailed(
70	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
71	  taskId: string,
72	  errorMessage: string,
73	): Promise<void> {
74	  try {
75	    await supabase.from("tasks").update({
76	      status: "Failed",
77	      error_message: errorMessage,
78	      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
79	    }).eq("id", taskId).in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"]);
80	  } catch {
81	    // Best-effort — don't mask the original error
82	  }
83	}
84	
85	export async function persistCompletionFollowUpIssues(
86	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
87	  taskId: string,
88	  existingResultData: unknown,
89	  issues: CompletionFollowUpIssue[],
90	): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: unknown }> {
91	  if (issues.length === 0) {
92	    return { ok: true };
93	  }
94	
95	  const baseResultData = asObjectRecord(existingResultData);
96	  const completionFollowUp = {
97	    status: 'degraded',
98	    recorded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
99	    issues,
100	  };
101	
102	  const { error } = await supabase
103	    .from('tasks')
104	    .update({
105	      result_data: {
106	        ...baseResultData,
107	        completion_follow_up: completionFollowUp,
108	      },
109	    })
110	    .eq('id', taskId);
111	
112	  if (error) {
113	    return { ok: false, error };
114	  }
115	
116	  return { ok: true };
117	}
118

120	 * Fetch task context with all required fields for the completion flow.
121	 * Uses a single query with FK join (tasks.task_type -> task_types.name).
122	 * Returns null if task not found or on error.
123	 */
124	export async function fetchTaskContext(
125	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
126	  taskId: string,
127	  logger?: CompletionLogger,
128	): Promise<TaskContext | null> {
129	  const { data: task, error } = await supabase
130	    .from("tasks")
131	    .select(`id, task_type, project_id, params, result_data, task_types!tasks_task_type_fkey(tool_type, category, content_type, variant_type)`)
132	    .eq("id", taskId)
133	    .single();
134	
135	  if (error || !task) {
136	    logger?.error('Failed to fetch task context', {
137	      task_id: taskId,
138	      fetch_error: toErrorMessage(error),
139	    });
140	    return null;
141	  }
142	
143	  const taskTypeInfo = task.task_types || {};
144	
145	  return {
146	    id: task.id,
147	    task_type: task.task_type,
148	    project_id: task.project_id,
149	    params: task.params || {},
150	    result_data: task.result_data,
151	    tool_type: taskTypeInfo.tool_type || 'unknown',
152	    category: taskTypeInfo.category || 'unknown',
153	    content_type: taskTypeInfo.content_type || 'image',
154	    variant_type: taskTypeInfo.variant_type || null,
155	  };
156	}

### 2. **Generation Creation & Routing** 

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/supabase/functions/complete_task/generation.ts` (Lines 238-368)

The `createGenerationFromTask` function implements **6 routing cases**:

1. **Regeneration** (line 280): Existing generation → create variant
2. **Variant on source** (line 298): `based_on` param present → create variant on that generation
3. **Variant on child** (line 175): `child_generation_id` present → create variant on existing child
4. **Stitch task** (line 179): `travel_stitch`/`join_final_stitch` → variant on parent
5. **Child generation** (line 183): `parent_generation_id` present → create child under parent
6. **Standalone** (line 187): Neither → independent generation

Routing is determined by `resolveGenerationRouteParams()` (line 143):
- Extracts `based_on`, `create_as_generation`, `childGenerationId`, `parentGenerationId`, `childOrder`, `isSingleItem`
- Detects if task is a stitch task (line 158-159)

### 3. **Single-Segment Detection & Auto-Promotion Logic**

**Key Detection Points:**

**A. Task Payload Snapshot** - `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/supabase/functions/_shared/taskPayloadSnapshot.ts` (Lines 106-119)

```typescript
export function resolveSnapshotIsSingleItem(snapshot: TaskPayloadSnapshot): boolean {
  const explicit = asBoolean(
    snapshot.orchestrationContract.is_single_item
      ?? snapshot.rawParams.is_single_item,
  );
  if (explicit !== null) {
    return explicit;
  }

  return (
    snapshot.rawParams.is_first_segment === true
    && snapshot.rawParams.is_last_segment === true
  );
}
```

**Single-item is TRUE when:**
- `is_single_item: true` param is set, OR
- `is_first_segment: true` AND `is_last_segment: true`

**B. Param Normalization** - `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/supabase/functions/complete_task/taskParamNormalizer.ts` (Lines 88-90)

When `isSingleItem` is true, params are flagged:
```typescript
if (isSingleItem) {
  normalizedParams._isSingleSegmentCase = true;
}
```

This flag is used downstream in `getChildVariantViewedAt()` to auto-mark the child variant as viewed.

### 4. **Auto-Promotion to Parent Generation**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/supabase/functions/complete_task/generation-handlers.ts` (Lines 328-388)

When `handleVariantOnChild()` detects a single-segment child (line 354):

```typescript
// SINGLE-SEGMENT PROPAGATION: If this child is the only child of its parent,
// also create a variant on the parent so the main generation updates automatically
if (isSingleSegmentChild && childGen.parent_generation_id) {
  // Check if parent already has variants - only make primary if it's the first
  const { count: existingParentVariants } = await supabase
    .from('generation_variants')
    .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
    .eq('generation_id', childGen.parent_generation_id);

  const isFirstParentVariant = (existingParentVariants || 0) === 0;
  const makeParentPrimary = isFirstParentVariant || makePrimary;

  // Creates variant on parent with propagated metadata
  await createVariant(
    supabase,
    childGen.parent_generation_id,
    publicUrl,
    thumbnailUrl,
    { ...variantParams, propagated_from_child: childGenId, created_from: 'single_segment_propagation' },
    makeParentPrimary,
    variantType,
    null
  );
}
```

**The logic:**
- When a child generation is the ONLY child of its parent (`isSingleSegmentChild`), automatically creates a variant on the parent generation
- This variant uses the same media URL and metadata as the child
- Marked as primary if it's the first variant on the parent
- The `propagated_from_child` param tracks the source

### 5. **Single-Child Detection** 

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/supabase/functions/complete_task/generation-parent.ts` (Lines 232-287)

Function `getChildVariantViewedAt()` determines if a generation is the only child:

```typescript
export async function getChildVariantViewedAt(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  options: {
    taskParams?: { _isSingleSegmentCase?: boolean };
    childGeneration?: { parent_generation_id: string | null; is_child: boolean };
    parentGenerationId?: string;
  }
): Promise<string | null> {
  // Fast path: Check explicit flag first
  if (options.taskParams?._isSingleSegmentCase === true) {
    return new Date().toISOString();
  }

  // Slow path: Count siblings to determine if single-segment
  const parentId = options.childGeneration?.parent_generation_id || options.parentGenerationId;
  const shouldCountSiblings = parentId && (
    options.childGeneration?.is_child === true ||
    (!options.childGeneration && options.parentGenerationId)
  );
  if (shouldCountSiblings) {
    const { count } = await supabase
      .from('generations')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('parent_generation_id', parentId)
      .eq('is_child', true);

    if (count === 1) {
      return new Date().toISOString();
    }
  }
  return null;
}
```

**Returns a timestamp** (marking as "viewed") if:
- `_isSingleSegmentCase` flag is true, OR
- Sibling count under parent equals 1

This timestamp is passed to `createVariant()` parameter `viewedAt`, marking the child as already viewed/consumed.

  },

**`isFinalStep: true`** means the task directly completes the orchestrator without sibling counting.

### Summary of Single-Segment Flow (1-2 Images)

For a shot with just 1-2 images (single segment):

1. **Task creation**: Sets `is_first_segment: true, is_last_segment: true`
2. **complete_task**: 
   - Detects `isSingleItem = true` via `resolveSnapshotIsSingleItem()`
   - Sets `_isSingleSegmentCase = true` in normalized params
3. **Child generation created**: Gets the segment video URL
4. **`getChildVariantViewedAt()` returns timestamp**: Because `_isSingleSegmentCase = true`
5. **Child variant marked as viewed**: Passed as `viewedAt` parameter to createVariant
6. **Parent variant auto-created** (in `handleVariantOnChild`):
   - Checks if parent has children → sibling count
   - If count = 1, creates variant on parent with same URL
   - Marked as primary if first variant
7. **UI displays**: Parent generation's location shows the video directly; child marked as viewed/consumed
8. **Orchestrator completion**: If final-step task, marks orchestrator Complete

No explicit "skip join" logic exists - instead, the single segment is automatically **promoted to the parent generation** so the final video appears at the parent level.

47	  isRefetching: boolean;
48	  refetch: () => void;
49	}
50	
51	function derivePreloadedParentGenerations(
52	  preloadedGenerations?: GenerationRow[],
53	): GenerationRow[] | undefined {
54	  if (!preloadedGenerations) {
55	    return undefined;
56	  }
57	
58	  const parentIds = new Set<string>();
59	  preloadedGenerations.forEach((generation) => {
60	    if (generation.parent_generation_id) {
61	      parentIds.add(generation.parent_generation_id);
62	    }
63	  });
64	
65	  const parents = preloadedGenerations.filter((generation) => {
66	    const isVideo = generation.type?.includes('video');
67	    const isNotChild = !generation.parent_generation_id;
68	    const hasOrchestratorDetails = !!(
69	      generation.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
70	    )?.orchestrator_details;
71	    const generationId = getGenerationId(generation);
72	    const hasChildren = typeof generationId === 'string' && parentIds.has(generationId);
73	
74	    return isVideo && isNotChild && (hasOrchestratorDetails || hasChildren);
75	  });
76	
77	  parents.sort(compareByCreatedAtDesc);
78	
79	  return parents;
80	}
81	
82	function derivePreloadedChildren(
83	  preloadedGenerations: GenerationRow[] | undefined,
84	  selectedParentId: string | null,
85	  parentGenerations: GenerationRow[],
86	): GenerationRow[] | undefined {
87	  if (!preloadedGenerations || !selectedParentId) {
88	    return undefined;
89	  }
90	
91	  const selectedParent = parentGenerations.find(
92	    (parent) => parent.id === selectedParentId || parent.generation_id === selectedParentId,
93	  );
94	  const parentGenerationId = selectedParent?.generation_id || selectedParentId;
95	
96	  return preloadedGenerations.filter((generation) => {
97	    const parentId = generation.parent_generation_id;
98	    return parentId === parentGenerationId || parentId === selectedParentId;
99	  });
100	}
101	
102	function derivePreloadedTimelineData(
103	  preloadedGenerations?: GenerationRow[],
104	): LiveTimelineRow[] | undefined {
105	  if (!preloadedGenerations) {
106	    return undefined;
107	  }
108	
109	  return preloadedGenerations
110	    .filter((generation) => (
111	      generation.timeline_frame !== null
112	      && generation.timeline_frame !== undefined
113	      && generation.timeline_frame >= 0
114	    ))
115	    .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0))
116	    .map((generation) => ({
117	      id: generation.id,
118	      generation_id: generation.generation_id,
119	      timeline_frame: generation.timeline_frame,
120	    }));
121	}
122	
123	function buildPositionMap(timelineData: LiveTimelineRow[] | undefined): Map<string, number> {
124	  const map = new Map<string, number>();
125	  (timelineData || []).forEach((timelineItem, index) => {
126	    map.set(timelineItem.id, index);
127	  });
128	  return map;
129	}

131	export function useSegmentOutputsForShot(
132	  shotId: string | null,

143	  const selectedParentId = isControlled ? controlledSelectedParentId : internalSelectedParentId;
144	  const setSelectedParentId = useCallback((id: string | null) => {

1	/**
2	 * useShotFinalVideos - Batch-fetches the latest final video for each shot in a project.
3	 *
4	 * Returns a map of shotId → ShotFinalVideo for shots that have
5	 * a completed final video. Used by the shot list to show video previews.
6	 */
7	
8	import { useMemo } from 'react';
9	import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
10	import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
11	import { finalVideoQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/finalVideos';
12

14	  id: string;
15	  location: string;
16	  thumbnailUrl: string | null;
17	}
18	
19	export function useShotFinalVideos(projectId: string | null) {
20	  const { data: rawData, isLoading } = useQuery({
21	    [REDACTED](projectId!),
22	    queryFn: async () => {
23	      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_final_videos')
24	        .select('id, location, thumbnail_url, shot_id, created_at')
25	        .eq('project_id', projectId!)
26	        .not('location', 'is', null)
27	        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
28	
29	      if (error) {
30	        console.error('[useShotFinalVideos] Error:', error);
31	        return [];
32	      }
33	      return data || [];
34	    },
35	    enabled: !!projectId,
36	    staleTime: 30_000,
37	  });
38	
39	  // Build map: shotId → latest final video (first per shot since ordered by created_at desc)
40	  const finalVideoMap = useMemo(() => {
41	    const map = new Map<string, ShotFinalVideo>();
42	    if (!rawData) return map;
43	
44	    for (const row of rawData) {
45	      const shotId = typeof (row as Record<string, unknown>).shot_id === 'string'
46	        ? (row as Record<string, unknown>).shot_id as string
47	        : null;
48	      const location = typeof row.location === 'string' ? row.location : null;
49	      const id = typeof row.id === 'string' ? row.id : null;
50	
51	      if (shotId && id && location && !map.has(shotId)) {
52	        map.set(shotId, {
53	          id,
54	          location,
55	          thumbnailUrl: row.thumbnail_url || null,
56	        });
57	      }
58	    }
59	    return map;
60	  }, [rawData]);
61	
62	  return { finalVideoMap, isLoading };
63	}

84	    return <ShotListEmptyState onCreateNewShot={onCreateNewShot} />;
85	  }
86	
87	  return (
88	    <DndContext

91	      onDragStart={handleDragStart}
92	      onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
93	    >

96	        strategy={rectSortingStrategy}
97	      >

102	              isNewShotDropTarget={pendingNewShot.isNewShotDropTarget}
103	              newShotDropType={pendingNewShot.newShotDropType}

106	              onDragLeave={pendingNewShot.handleNewShotDragLeave}

109	            />

111	
112	          {pendingNewShot.pendingSkeletonShot && (
113	            <PendingSkeletonShotCard pendingSkeletonShot={pendingNewShot.pendingSkeletonShot} />

116	          {shots.map((shot, index) => {

1	/**
2	 * Shared download logic for ImageLightbox and VideoLightbox
3	 *
4	 * Resolves the correct URL (from intended variant or effective URL),
5	 * extracts prompt for filename, and delegates to downloadMedia.
6	 */
7	
8	import type { GenerationVariant } from '@/shared/hooks/variants/useVariants';
9	import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
10	import { readSegmentOverrides } from '@/shared/lib/settingsMigration';
11	import { downloadMedia } from '@/shared/lib/media/downloadMedia';
12	
13	interface LightboxDownloadOptions {
14	  /** Ref to the variant the user intends to download (synchronous, avoids race condition) */
15	  intendedVariantId: string | null;
16	  /** All loaded variants */
17	  variants: GenerationVariant[];
18	  /** Fallback URL when no variant matches */
19	  fallbackUrl: string;
20	  /** The media object for id, metadata, params, contentType */
21	  media: GenerationRow;
22	  /** Whether this is a video download */
23	  isVideo: boolean;
24	  /** Called with true/false to manage download loading state */
25	  setIsDownloading: (v: boolean) => void;
26	}
27	
28	/**
29	 * Execute a lightbox download with variant resolution and prompt-based filename.
30	 */
31	export async function handleLightboxDownload({
32	  intendedVariantId,
33	  variants,
34	  fallbackUrl,
35	  media,
36	  isVideo,
37	  setIsDownloading,
38	}: LightboxDownloadOptions): Promise<void> {
39	  let urlToDownload: string | undefined;
40	
41	  if (intendedVariantId && variants.length > 0) {
42	    const intendedVariant = variants.find((v) => v.id === intendedVariantId);
43	    if (intendedVariant?.location) {
44	      urlToDownload = intendedVariant.location;
45	    }
46	  }
47	
48	  if (!urlToDownload) {
49	    urlToDownload = fallbackUrl;
50	  }
51	
52	  if (!urlToDownload) return;
53	
54	  setIsDownloading(true);
55	  try {
56	    const segmentOverrides = readSegmentOverrides(media.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
57	    const prompt = media.params?.prompt ||
58	                   (media.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.enhanced_prompt as string | undefined ||
59	                   segmentOverrides.prompt ||
60	                   (media.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.prompt as string | undefined;
61	    await downloadMedia(urlToDownload, media.id, isVideo, media.contentType, prompt);
62	  } finally {
63	    setIsDownloading(false);
64	  }
65	}
66

1	-- ============================================================================
2	-- CRITICAL SECURITY FIX: Views bypassing RLS
3	-- ============================================================================
4	-- VULNERABILITY: Views run with owner permissions, bypassing RLS on underlying
5	-- tables. Any authenticated user can query these views and see ALL users' data.
6	--
7	-- FIX: Recreate views with security_invoker = true (PostgreSQL 15+)
8	-- This makes views respect the RLS policies of the underlying tables.
9	-- ============================================================================
10	
11	BEGIN;
12	
13	-- ============================================================================
14	-- 1. shot_statistics - Exposes all shots/generations for all users
15	-- ============================================================================
16	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS shot_statistics;
17	
18	CREATE VIEW shot_statistics
19	WITH (security_invoker = true)
20	AS
21	SELECT
22	  s.id as shot_id,
23	  s.project_id,
24	  COUNT(sg.id) as total_generations,
25	  COUNT(sg.id) FILTER (WHERE sg.timeline_frame IS NOT NULL) as positioned_count,
26	  COUNT(sg.id) FILTER (WHERE sg.timeline_frame IS NULL AND (g.type IS NULL OR g.type NOT LIKE '%video%')) as unpositioned_count,
27	  COUNT(sg.id) FILTER (WHERE g.params->>'tool_type' = 'travel-between-images' AND g.type LIKE '%video%') as video_count,
28	  COUNT(sg.id) FILTER (
29	    WHERE g.type = 'video'
30	    AND g.parent_generation_id IS NULL
31	    AND g.location IS NOT NULL
32	    AND g.location != ''
33	    AND (
34	      g.params->'orchestrator_details' IS NOT NULL
35	      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generations c WHERE c.parent_generation_id = g.id)
36	    )
37	  ) as final_video_count
38	FROM shots s
39	LEFT JOIN shot_generations sg ON sg.shot_id = s.id
40	LEFT JOIN generations g ON g.id = sg.generation_id
41	GROUP BY s.id, s.project_id;
42	
43	GRANT SELECT ON shot_statistics TO authenticated;
44	
45	-- ============================================================================
46	-- 2. shot_final_videos - Exposes all video URLs for all users
47	-- ============================================================================
48	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS shot_final_videos;
49	
50	CREATE VIEW shot_final_videos
51	WITH (security_invoker = true)
52	AS
53	SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.id)
54	  g.id,
55	  g.location,
56	  g.thumbnail_url,
57	  g.type,
58	  g.created_at,
59	  g.updated_at,
60	  g.params,
61	  g.starred,
62	  g.project_id,
63	  sg.shot_id
64	FROM generations g
65	JOIN shot_generations sg ON sg.generation_id = g.id
66	WHERE g.type = 'video'
67	  AND g.parent_generation_id IS NULL
68	  AND (
69	    g.params->'orchestrator_details' IS NOT NULL
70	    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generations c WHERE c.parent_generation_id = g.id)
71	  );
72	
73	GRANT SELECT ON shot_final_videos TO authenticated;
74	
75	-- ============================================================================
76	-- 3. user_credit_balance - Exposes all users' credit balances
77	-- ============================================================================
78	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS user_credit_balance;
79	
80	CREATE VIEW user_credit_balance
81	WITH (security_invoker = true)
82	AS
83	SELECT
84	  user_id,
85	  SUM(amount) as balance
86	FROM credits_ledger
87	GROUP BY user_id;
88	
89	GRANT SELECT ON user_credit_balance TO authenticated;
90	
91	-- ============================================================================
92	-- 4. shot_generations_with_computed_position - Exposes all shot_generations

94	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS shot_generations_with_computed_position;

96	CREATE VIEW shot_generations_with_computed_position

15	export async function fetchParentGenerations(
16	  shotId: string,
17	  projectId: string | null,
18	): Promise<GenerationRow[]> {
19	  if (!projectId) return [];
20	  const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_final_videos')

28	      context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchParents',
29	      showToast: false,
30	      logData: { shotId, projectId },
31	    });
32	    throw error;
33	  }
34	
35	  return coerceRawGenerationDbRows(data || []).map(transformToGenerationRow);
36	}
37	
38	export function buildChildrenQueryKey(selectedParentId: string) {

65	export async function fetchLiveTimeline(shotId: string): Promise<LiveTimelineRow[]> {
66	  const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
67	    .select('id, generation_id, timeline_frame')
68	    .eq('shot_id', shotId)
69	    .gte('timeline_frame', 0)
70	    .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
71	
72	  if (error) {
73	    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {

75	      showToast: false,

### **2.4 shot_final_videos View (Database)**
- **File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/supabase/migrations/20260130230000_critical_fix_view_security.sql` (lines 50-71)
- **Definition**:
  ```sql
  CREATE VIEW shot_final_videos
  WITH (security_invoker = true)
  AS
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.id)
    g.id, g.location, g.thumbnail_url, g.type, g.created_at, 
    g.updated_at, g.params, g.starred, g.project_id, sg.shot_id
  FROM generations g
  JOIN shot_generations sg ON sg.generation_id = g.id
  WHERE g.type = 'video'
    AND g.parent_generation_id IS NULL
    AND (g.params->'orchestrator_details' IS NOT NULL
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generations c WHERE c.parent_generation_id = g.id))
  ```
- **Purpose**: Materialized view joining generations with their shot association for fast final video lookup
- **Security**: Uses `security_invoker = true` to respect RLS policies

## **7. KEY DATA FIELDS USED DOWNSTREAM**

For final videos, these fields are critical:

1. **`generation.location`** - Direct URL to video file
   - Used in: Every display component, downloads, sharing, lightbox
   
2. **`generation.thumbnail_url`** - Preview thumbnail
   - Used in: Shot list cards, gallery previews
   
3. **`generation.id`** - Generation identifier
   - Used in: Task mapping, sharing, variant lookups
   
4. **`generation.params.orchestrator_details`** - Metadata about generation
   - Used in: Identifying if it's a final video, task context, billing
   
5. **`generation.parent_generation_id`** - NULL for final videos (IS NULL check)
   - Used in: Filtering to only show top-level parents
   
6. **`generation.created_at`** - Timestamp
   - Used in: Sorting, "Output N of M" selector, share display
   
7. **`shot_generations.timeline_frame`** - Frame position
   - Used in: Segment positioning, timeline rendering
   
8. **`shared_generations.share_slug`** - Share identifier
   - Used in: Building /share/[slug] URLs

This breaks the promised transition back to normal multi-segment flow unless the parent id is still carried through the view and the downstream consumers are updated accordingly.",
      "category": "correctness"
    }

1	/**
2	 * Shot-scoped image queries. Queries shot_generations JOIN generations.
3	 * Exports: useShotImages, useTimelineImages, useUnpositionedImages, useVideoOutputs.
4	 */
5	
6	import { useQuery, useQueryClient, UseQueryResult } from '@tanstack/react-query';
7	import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
8	import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
9	import { QUERY_PRESETS, STANDARD_RETRY, STANDARD_RETRY_DELAY } from '@/shared/lib/query/queryDefaults';
10	import { generationQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/generations';
11	import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
12	import React from 'react';
13	
14	import { mapShotGenerationToRow } from '@/shared/hooks/shots';
15	import {
16	  selectTimelineImages,
17	  selectUnpositionedImages,
18	  selectVideoOutputs,
19	} from '@/shared/lib/shotImageSelectors';
20	
21	/** Loads all shot_generations (positioned + unpositioned) for a shot. */
22	const useAllShotGenerations = (
23	  shotId: string | null,
24	  options?: {
25	    // When true, prevents query from refetching during sensitive operations (drag, persist, etc.)
26	    disableRefetch?: boolean;
27	  }
28	): UseQueryResult<GenerationRow[]> => {
29	  const stableShotId = React.useMemo(() => shotId, [shotId]);
30	  const isEnabled = React.useMemo(() => {
31	    if (options?.disableRefetch) {
32	      return false;
33	    }
34	    return !!stableShotId;
35	  }, [stableShotId, options?.disableRefetch]);
36	  
37	  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
38	
39	  const mainQuery = useQuery<GenerationRow[], Error>({
40	    [REDACTED](stableShotId!),
41	    enabled: isEnabled,
42	    // Use realtimeBacked preset - data freshness from realtime + mutations
43	    // (invalidated by RealtimeProvider + useGenerationInvalidation)
44	    ...QUERY_PRESETS.realtimeBacked,
45	    // realtimeBacked provides staleTime: 30_000 — don't override to 0.
46	    // staleTime: 0 makes the query perpetually stale, which combined with React Query's
47	    // observer.setOptions() running every render causes a fetch→render→fetch loop.
48	    // refetchOnMount: 'always' ensures fresh data when opening a shot without the loop.
49	    refetchOnMount: 'always',
50	    retry: STANDARD_RETRY,
51	    // NOTE: Removed placeholderData: (previousData) => previousData
52	    // This was causing cross-shot data leakage - when navigating to a new shot,
53	    // the previous shot's images would briefly appear as "placeholder" data
54	    queryFn: async ({ signal }) => {
55	      // Query shot_generations with embedded generations data + primary variant
56	      // NOTE: Must specify FK explicitly to avoid ambiguous relationship error (PGRST201)
57	      // since there are two FKs between shot_generations and generations
58	      // We also fetch the primary_variant using the generations.primary_variant_id FK
59	      // to get the correct display URL (primary variant may differ from generation.location)
60	      const response = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
61	        .select(`
62	          id,
63	          generation_id,
64	          timeline_frame,
65	          metadata,
66	          generation:generations!shot_generations_generation_id_generations_id_fk (
67	            id,
68	            location,
69	            thumbnail_url,
70	            type,
71	            created_at,
72	            starred,
73	            name,
74	            based_on,
75	            params,
76	            primary_variant_id,
77	            primary_variant:generation_variants!generations_primary_variant_id_fkey (
78	              location,
79	              thumbnail_url
80	            )
81	          )
82	        `)
83	        .eq('shot_id', stableShotId!)
84	        .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true, nullsFirst: false })
85	        .abortSignal(signal);
86	      
87	      if (response.error) {
88	        // Abort errors are expected during rapid invalidations - silently return cached data
89	        if (response.error.code === '20' || response.error.message?.includes('abort')) {
90	          const cachedData = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(generationQueryKeys.byShot(stableShotId!));
91	          return cachedData || [];
92	        }
93	        normalizeAndPresentError(response.error, {
94	          context: 'useShotImages.queryFn',
95	          showToast: false,
96	          logData: { shotId: stableShotId },
97	        });
98	        throw response.error;
99	      }
100	
101	      return (response.data || [])
102	        .map(mapShotGenerationToRow)
103	        .filter(Boolean) as GenerationRow[];
104	    },
105	    retryDelay: STANDARD_RETRY_DELAY,
106	  });
107	
108	  return mainQuery as UseQueryResult<GenerationRow[]>;
109	};
110	
111	/** Positioned, non-video images with valid location, sorted by timeline_frame. */
112	export const useTimelineImages = (
113	  shotId: string | null
114	): UseQueryResult<GenerationRow[]> => {
115	  const baseQuery = useAllShotGenerations(shotId);
116	
117	  const filtered = React.useMemo(() => {
118	    if (!baseQuery.data) return undefined;
119	
120	    return selectTimelineImages(baseQuery.data);
121	  }, [baseQuery.data]);
122	
123	  return { ...baseQuery, data: filtered } as UseQueryResult<GenerationRow[]>;
124	};
125

127	export const useUnpositionedImages = (

129	): UseQueryResult<GenerationRow[]> => {
130	  const baseQuery = useAllShotGenerations(shotId);
131	
132	  const filtered = React.useMemo(() => {

135	    return selectUnpositionedImages(baseQuery.data);
136	  }, [baseQuery.data]);
137	
138	  return { ...baseQuery, data: filtered } as UseQueryResult<GenerationRow[]>;
139	};

142	export const useVideoOutputs = (

144	): UseQueryResult<GenerationRow[]> => {
145	  const baseQuery = useAllShotGenerations(shotId);
146	  
147	  const filtered = React.useMemo(() => {
148	    if (!baseQuery.data) return undefined;

150	    return selectVideoOutputs(baseQuery.data);

154	};

156	/** Seeds the shot-generations cache from ShotsContext for instant display on shot select. */
157	const usePrimeShotGenerationsCache = (
158	  shotId: string | null,
159	  contextImages: GenerationRow[] | undefined
160	) => {
161	  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
162	  
163	  React.useEffect(() => {
164	    if (!shotId || !contextImages || contextImages.length === 0) return;
165	
166	    const existingData = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(generationQueryKeys.byShot(shotId));
167	    if (existingData && existingData.length > 0) return;
168	
169	    // Prime the cache with context data
170	    queryClient.setQueryData(generationQueryKeys.byShot(shotId), contextImages);
171	  }, [shotId, contextImages, queryClient]);
172	};
173	
174	export const useShotImages = useAllShotGenerations;
175	export const usePrimeShotImagesCache = usePrimeShotGenerationsCache;

1	/**
2	 * Hook for computing pair data from shot generations.
3	 * Pure computation - no side effects, no state management.
4	 */
5	
6	import { useMemo } from 'react';
7	import type { PairData } from '../../Timeline/TimelineContainer/types';
8	import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
9	import { isVideoAny } from '@/shared/lib/typeGuards';
10	import { readSegmentOverrides } from '@/shared/lib/settingsMigration';
11	
12	interface UsePairDataProps {
13	  /** Shot generations (images) */
14	  shotGenerations: GenerationRow[];
15	  /** Current generation mode */
16	  generationMode: 'batch' | 'timeline' | 'by-pair';
17	  /** Frame spacing for batch mode */
18	  batchVideoFrames: number;
19	}
20	
21	interface UsePairDataReturn {
22	  /** Map of pair index to pair data */
23	  pairDataByIndex: Map<number, PairData>;
24	}
25	
26	/**
27	 * Helper to read end_frame from image metadata.
28	 * Returns undefined if not set.
29	 */
30	function getEndFrameFromMetadata(metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): number | undefined {
31	  if (!metadata) return undefined;
32	  const endFrame = metadata.end_frame;
33	  return typeof endFrame === 'number' ? endFrame : undefined;
34	}
35	
36	/**
37	 * Computes pair data from shot generations.
38	 * Each pair represents two consecutive images that can generate a video segment.
39	 *
40	 * For the last image (or single image), if metadata.end_frame is set, a trailing
41	 * pair is created with endImage: undefined. This handles both single-image mode
42	 * and multi-image timelines with a trailing segment.
43	 */
44	export function usePairData({
45	  shotGenerations,
46	  generationMode,
47	  batchVideoFrames,
48	}: UsePairDataProps): UsePairDataReturn {
49	  return useMemo(() => {
50	    const dataMap = new Map<number, PairData>();
51	
52	    // Filter and sort images
53	    const sortedImages = [...(shotGenerations || [])]
54	      .filter((img) => img.timeline_frame != null && img.timeline_frame >= 0 && !isVideoAny(img))
55	      .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0));
56	
57	    if (sortedImages.length === 0) {
58	      return { pairDataByIndex: dataMap };
59	    }
60	
61	    const isBatchMode = generationMode !== 'timeline';
62	
63	    // Build pairs from consecutive images
64	    for (let pairIndex = 0; pairIndex < sortedImages.length - 1; pairIndex++) {
65	      const startImage = sortedImages[pairIndex];
66	      const endImage = sortedImages[pairIndex + 1];
67	
68	      // Read per-segment overrides from metadata
69	      const startImageOverrides = readSegmentOverrides(startImage.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
70	      const pairNumFramesFromMetadata = startImageOverrides.numFrames;
71	
72	      // Calculate frame positions based on mode
73	      const startFrame = isBatchMode
74	        ? pairIndex * batchVideoFrames
75	        : (startImage.timeline_frame ?? 0);
76	      const endFrame = isBatchMode
77	        ? (pairIndex + 1) * batchVideoFrames
78	        : (endImage.timeline_frame ?? 0);
79	      const frames = isBatchMode
80	        ? (pairNumFramesFromMetadata ?? batchVideoFrames)
81	        : endFrame - startFrame;
82	
83	      dataMap.set(pairIndex, {
84	        index: pairIndex,
85	        frames,
86	        startFrame,
87	        endFrame,
88	        startImage: {
89	          id: startImage.id,
90	          generationId: startImage.generation_id || undefined,
91	          primaryVariantId: startImage.primary_variant_id || undefined,
92	          url: startImage.imageUrl || startImage.location || undefined,
93	          thumbUrl: startImage.thumbUrl || startImage.location || undefined,
94	          position: pairIndex + 1,
95	        },
96	        endImage: {
97	          id: endImage.id,
98	          generationId: endImage.generation_id || undefined,
99	          primaryVariantId: endImage.primary_variant_id || undefined,
100	          url: endImage.imageUrl || endImage.location || undefined,
101	          thumbUrl: endImage.thumbUrl || endImage.location || undefined,
102	          position: pairIndex + 2,
103	        },
104	      });
105	    }
106	
107	    // Check if the last image has an end_frame for a trailing segment
108	    // This handles both single-image (sortedImages.length === 1) and multi-image trailing segments
109	    const lastImage = sortedImages[sortedImages.length - 1];
110	    const lastImageEndFrame = getEndFrameFromMetadata(lastImage.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
111	
112	    if (lastImageEndFrame !== undefined) {
113	      const trailingPairIndex = sortedImages.length - 1;
114	      const startFrame = isBatchMode
115	        ? trailingPairIndex * batchVideoFrames
116	        : (lastImage.timeline_frame ?? 0);
117	
118	      // Read numFrames override for batch mode
119	      const lastImageOverrides = readSegmentOverrides(lastImage.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
120	      const trailingNumFrames = lastImageOverrides.numFrames;
121	
122	      const frames = isBatchMode
123	        ? (trailingNumFrames ?? batchVideoFrames)
124	        : lastImageEndFrame - startFrame;
125	
126	      dataMap.set(trailingPairIndex, {
127	        index: trailingPairIndex,
128	        frames,
129	        startFrame,
130	        endFrame: lastImageEndFrame,
131	        startImage: {
132	          id: lastImage.id,
133	          generationId: lastImage.generation_id || undefined,
134	          primaryVariantId: lastImage.primary_variant_id || undefined,
135	          url: lastImage.imageUrl || lastImage.location || undefined,
136	          thumbUrl: lastImage.thumbUrl || lastImage.location || undefined,
137	          position: trailingPairIndex + 1,
138	        },
139	        endImage: null,

1	import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
2	import { getMediaUrl } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaTypeHelpers';
3	
4	const PLACEHOLDER_LOCATION = '/placeholder.svg';
5	
6	export function hasValidImageLocation(generation: GenerationRow): boolean {
7	  const location = getMediaUrl(generation);
8	  return Boolean(location && location !== PLACEHOLDER_LOCATION);
9	}
10	
11	function isVideoOutputGeneration(generation: GenerationRow): boolean {
12	  return Boolean(generation.type?.includes('video'));
13	}
14	
15	function isTimelineImageGeneration(generation: GenerationRow): boolean {
16	  return (
17	    generation.timeline_frame != null &&
18	    generation.timeline_frame >= 0 &&
19	    !isVideoOutputGeneration(generation) &&
20	    hasValidImageLocation(generation)
21	  );
22	}
23	
24	function isUnpositionedImageGeneration(generation: GenerationRow): boolean {
25	  return (
26	    generation.timeline_frame == null &&
27	    !isVideoOutputGeneration(generation) &&
28	    hasValidImageLocation(generation)
29	  );
30	}
31	
32	export function selectTimelineImages(generations: GenerationRow[]): GenerationRow[] {
33	  return generations
34	    .filter(isTimelineImageGeneration)
35	    .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0));
36	}
37	
38	export function selectUnpositionedImages(generations: GenerationRow[]): GenerationRow[] {
39	  return generations.filter(isUnpositionedImageGeneration);
40	}
41	
42	export function selectVideoOutputs(generations: GenerationRow[]): GenerationRow[] {
43	  return generations.filter(isVideoOutputGeneration);
44	}
