1	import { useMemo } from 'react';
2	import { getPairInfo, sortPositionEntries, TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY } from '../../utils/timeline-utils';
3	import { TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET } from '../../constants';
4	import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
5	import type { PairData } from '../../TimelineContainer/types';
6	
7	interface UseComputedTimelineDataProps {
8	  currentPositions: Map<string, number>;
9	  images: GenerationRow[];
10	
11	  containerWidth: number;
12	  fullRange: number;
13	  zoomLevel: number;
14	}
15	
16	interface UseComputedTimelineDataReturn {
17	  pairInfo: ReturnType<typeof getPairInfo>;
18	  pairDataByIndex: Map<number, PairData>;
19	  localShotGenPositions: Map<string, number>;
20	  showPairLabels: boolean;
21	}
22	
23	export function useComputedTimelineData({
24	  currentPositions,
25	  images,
26	
27	  containerWidth,
28	  fullRange,
29	  zoomLevel,
30	}: UseComputedTimelineDataProps): UseComputedTimelineDataReturn {
31	  const pairInfo = useMemo(() => getPairInfo(currentPositions), [currentPositions]);
32	
33	  // Image-only positions (excluding trailing endpoint key)
34	  const imageOnlyPositions = useMemo(() => {
35	    const filtered = new Map(currentPositions);
36	    filtered.delete(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
37	    return filtered;
38	  }, [currentPositions]);
39	
40	  // Compute shot_generation_id -> position index map
41	  const localShotGenPositions = useMemo(() => {
42	    const posMap = new Map<string, number>();
43	    const sortedEntries = sortPositionEntries(imageOnlyPositions);
44	    sortedEntries.forEach(([shotGenId], index) => {
45	      posMap.set(shotGenId, index);
46	    });
47	    return posMap;
48	  }, [imageOnlyPositions]);
49	
50	  // Compute full pair data for each pair index
51	  const pairDataByIndex = useMemo(() => {
52	    const dataMap = new Map<number, PairData>();
53	    const sortedEntries = sortPositionEntries(imageOnlyPositions);
54	    for (let pairIndex = 0; pairIndex < sortedEntries.length - 1; pairIndex++) {
55	      const [startId, startFrame] = sortedEntries[pairIndex];
56	      const [endId, endFrame] = sortedEntries[pairIndex + 1];
57	      const startImage = images.find(img => img.id === startId);
58	      const endImage = images.find(img => img.id === endId);
59	      dataMap.set(pairIndex, {
60	        index: pairIndex,
61	        frames: endFrame - startFrame,
62	        startFrame,
63	        endFrame,
64	        startImage: startImage ? {
65	          id: startImage.id,
66	          generationId: startImage.generation_id,
67	          url: startImage.imageUrl || startImage.thumbUrl,
68	          thumbUrl: startImage.thumbUrl,
69	          position: pairIndex + 1,
70	        } : null,
71	        endImage: endImage ? {
72	          id: endImage.id,
73	          generationId: endImage.generation_id,
74	          url: endImage.imageUrl || endImage.thumbUrl,
75	          thumbUrl: endImage.thumbUrl,
76	          position: pairIndex + 2,
77	        } : null,
78	      });
79	    }
80	    return dataMap;
81	  }, [imageOnlyPositions, images]);
82	
83	  // Calculate whether to show pair labels
84	  const showPairLabels = useMemo(() => {
85	    if (images.length < 2) return false;
86	    const sortedPositions = sortPositionEntries(imageOnlyPositions);
87	    let totalPairWidth = 0;
88	    let pairCount = 0;
89	    for (let i = 0; i < sortedPositions.length - 1; i++) {
90	      const [, startFrame] = sortedPositions[i];
91	      const [, endFrame] = sortedPositions[i + 1];
92	      const frameWidth = endFrame - startFrame;
93	      const effectiveWidth = containerWidth - (TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET * 2);
94	      const pixelWidth = (frameWidth / fullRange) * effectiveWidth * zoomLevel;
95	      totalPairWidth += pixelWidth;
96	      pairCount++;
97	    }
98	    const avgPairWidth = pairCount > 0 ? totalPairWidth / pairCount : 0;
99	    return avgPairWidth >= 100;
100	  }, [images.length, imageOnlyPositions, containerWidth, fullRange, zoomLevel]);
101	
102	  return {
103	    pairInfo,
104	    pairDataByIndex,
105	    localShotGenPositions,
106	    showPairLabels,
107	  };
108	}
109

128	export function useSegmentLightboxState(
129	  segmentSlots: SegmentSlot[],
130	  onPairClick?: ShotImageManagerProps['onPairClick']
131	): SegmentLightboxState {
132	  const [segmentLightboxIndex, setSegmentLightboxIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
133	
134	  const handleSegmentClick = useCallback((slotIndex: number) => {
135	    const slot = segmentSlots[slotIndex];
136	    if (onPairClick && slot) {
137	      onPairClick(slot.index);
138	      return;
139	    }
140	
141	    setSegmentLightboxIndex(slotIndex);
142	  }, [onPairClick, segmentSlots]);
143	
144	  const currentSegmentSlot = segmentLightboxIndex !== null ? segmentSlots[segmentLightboxIndex] : null;
145	  const currentSegmentMedia = currentSegmentSlot?.type === 'child'
146	    ? currentSegmentSlot.child
147	    : null;
148	
149	  const segmentChildSlotIndices = useMemo(
150	    () =>
151	      segmentSlots
152	        .map((slot, idx) => (slot.type === 'child' && slot.child.location ? idx : null))
153	        .filter((idx): idx is number => idx !== null),
154	    [segmentSlots]
155	  );
156	
157	  const handleSegmentLightboxNext = useCallback(() => {
158	    if (segmentLightboxIndex === null || segmentChildSlotIndices.length === 0) {
159	      return;
160	    }
161	
162	    const currentPos = segmentChildSlotIndices.indexOf(segmentLightboxIndex);

18	const VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov'] as const;
19	
20	export function hasVideoExtension(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
21	  if (!url) return false;
22	  const lower = url.toLowerCase();
23	  return VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.some(ext => lower.endsWith(ext));
24	}
25	
26	export function isVideoGeneration(gen: GenerationRow): boolean {

28	    gen.type === 'video' ||

31	    hasVideoExtension(gen.imageUrl)
32	  );
33	}

46	  location?: string | null;
47	  imageUrl?: string | null;

49	  thumbUrl?: string | null;
50	  generation?: { type?: string; location?: string } | null;
51	  generations?: { type?: string; location?: string } | null;
52	}): boolean {

54	  if (hasVideoExtension(item.location)) return true;
55	  if (hasVideoExtension(item.imageUrl)) return true;
56	  if (hasVideoExtension(item.url)) return true;

58	  if (item.generation?.type === 'video' || item.generation?.type === 'video_travel_output') return true;
59	  if (hasVideoExtension(item.generation?.location)) return true;
60	  if (item.generations?.type === 'video' || item.generations?.type === 'video_travel_output') return true;
61	  if (hasVideoExtension(item.generations?.location)) return true;
62	  return false;
63	}

51	function derivePreloadedParentGenerations(
52	  preloadedGenerations?: GenerationRow[],
53	): GenerationRow[] | undefined {
54	  if (!preloadedGenerations) {
55	    return undefined;
56	  }
57	
58	  const parentIds = new Set<string>();
59	  preloadedGenerations.forEach((generation) => {
60	    if (generation.parent_generation_id) {
61	      parentIds.add(generation.parent_generation_id);
62	    }
63	  });
64	
65	  const parents = preloadedGenerations.filter((generation) => {
66	    const isVideo = generation.type?.includes('video');
67	    const isNotChild = !generation.parent_generation_id;
68	    const hasOrchestratorDetails = !!(
69	      generation.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
70	    )?.orchestrator_details;
71	    const generationId = getGenerationId(generation);
72	    const hasChildren = typeof generationId === 'string' && parentIds.has(generationId);
73	
74	    return isVideo && isNotChild && (hasOrchestratorDetails || hasChildren);
75	  });
76	
77	  parents.sort(compareByCreatedAtDesc);
78	
79	  return parents;
80	}

87	  if (!preloadedGenerations || !selectedParentId) {

90

93	  );

95	
96	  return preloadedGenerations.filter((generation) => {
97	    const parentId = generation.parent_generation_id;
98	    return parentId === parentGenerationId || parentId === selectedParentId;
99	  });
100	}

15	export async function fetchParentGenerations(
16	  shotId: string,
17	  projectId: string | null,
18	): Promise<GenerationRow[]> {
19	  if (!projectId) return [];
20	  const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_final_videos')
21	    .select('*')
22	    .eq('shot_id', shotId)
23	    .eq('project_id', projectId)
24	    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
25	
26	  if (error) {
27	    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
28	      context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchParents',
29	      showToast: false,
30	      logData: { shotId, projectId },
31	    });
32	    throw error;
33	  }
34	
35	  return coerceRawGenerationDbRows(data || []).map(transformToGenerationRow);
36	}
37	
38	export function buildChildrenQueryKey(selectedParentId: string) {
39	  return segmentQueryKeys.children(selectedParentId);
40	}
41	
42	export async function fetchChildGenerations(selectedParentId: string): Promise<GenerationRow[]> {
43	  const { data, error } = await supabase().from('generations')
44	    .select('*')
45	    .eq('parent_generation_id', selectedParentId)
46	    .order('child_order', { ascending: true })
47	    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
48	
49	  if (error) {
50	    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
51	      context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchChildren',
52	      showToast: false,
53	      logData: { selectedParentId },
54	    });
55	    throw error;
56	  }
57	
58	  return coerceRawGenerationDbRows(data || []).map(transformToGenerationRow);
59	}

61	export function buildLiveTimelineQueryKey(shotId: string) {
62	  return segmentQueryKeys.liveTimeline(shotId);
63	}

65	export async function fetchLiveTimeline(shotId: string): Promise<LiveTimelineRow[]> {
66	  const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')

77	    });

## Summary: Timeline/Batch Item Count Determination

Based on my thorough code analysis, here's exactly how the timeline and batch view determine the number of items shown for a shot:

---

### 1. **How Timeline Determines Which Generations to Display as "Images"**

**Timeline queries images via `useShotImages` (aka `useAllShotGenerations`)**
- File: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/src/shared/hooks/shots/useShotImages.ts` (lines 22-109)
- Query: `shot_generations` table with embedded `generations` data
- **Ordered by**: `timeline_frame` ascending (line 84)

**Images are then filtered using `selectTimelineImages` selector:**
- File: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/src/shared/lib/shotImageSelectors.ts` (lines 32-36)

The filter logic (lines 15-22):
```typescript
function isTimelineImageGeneration(generation: GenerationRow): boolean {
  return (
    generation.timeline_frame != null &&
    generation.timeline_frame >= 0 &&
    !isVideoOutputGeneration(generation) &&
    hasValidImageLocation(generation)
  );
}

export function selectTimelineImages(generations: GenerationRow[]): GenerationRow[] {
  return generations
    .filter(isTimelineImageGeneration)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0));
}
```

**Key criteria for a "positioned generation" on timeline:**
1. `timeline_frame IS NOT NULL`
2. `timeline_frame >= 0` (must be a valid, non-negative frame)
3. Must NOT be a video (type excludes 'video' and 'video_travel_output')
4. Must have valid location (not placeholder URL)

---

### 2. **`timeline_frame` - How It's Set**

The `timeline_frame` field is a column in the `shot_generations` table that stores the frame position where a generation is placed on the timeline.

**Query that fetches timeline positions for segments:**
- File: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/src/shared/hooks/segments/segmentOutputsQueries.ts` (lines 65-82)

```typescript
export async function fetchLiveTimeline(shotId: string): Promise<LiveTimelineRow[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    .select('id, generation_id, timeline_frame')
    .eq('shot_id', shotId)
    .gte('timeline_frame', 0)  // Filters for >= 0
    .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
  // ...
}
```

---

### 3. **Batch Mode Item Determination**

**Batch mode uses the same filtered images** - it receives `images` array that's already been filtered to positioned, non-video generations.

- File: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/src/tools/travel-between-images/components/ShotImagesEditor/components/BatchModeContent.tsx` (lines 90-159)

The `images` prop passed to `BatchModeContent` is already the filtered timeline images from the parent `ShotEditor`, which calls:
- File: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/src/tools/travel-between-images/components/ShotEditor/hooks/editor-state/useShotEditorSetup.ts` (lines 114-116)

```typescript
const timelineImages = useMemo(() => {
  return selectTimelineImages(allShotImages);
}, [allShotImages]);
```

**The batch count is therefore: `images.length`** where images = all timeline images (positioned, non-video, with valid location)

---

### 4. **`usePairData` - How It Determines Pairs from Timeline Items**

File: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/src/tools/travel-between-images/components/ShotImagesEditor/hooks/usePairData.ts` (lines 44-145)

The hook filters the same way (lines 53-55):
```typescript
const sortedImages = [...(shotGenerations || [])]
  .filter((img) => img.timeline_frame != null && img.timeline_frame >= 0 && !isVideoAny(img))
  .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0));
```

**Number of pairs determined by:**
- Consecutive pairs: `(images.length - 1)` pairs
- Trailing pair (if last image has `metadata.end_frame`): 1 additional pair
- Total pairs: `sortedImages.length - 1` + (1 if trailing else 0)

### 5. **`useShotImages` Hook - Complete Data Flow**

File: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-app/src/shared/hooks/shots/useShotImages.ts`

Three main exported hooks:
- **`useShotImages` (line 174)**: Returns ALL shot generations (positioned + unpositioned)
- **`useTimelineImages` (lines 112-124)**: Filters to only timeline images (positioned, non-video, valid location)
- **`useUnpositionedImages` (lines 127-139)**: Filters to unpositioned images
- **`useVideoOutputs` (lines 142-154)**: Filters to video generations only

Data source: `shot_generations` JOIN `generations` with:
- Selects: `id, generation_id, timeline_frame, metadata, generation {...}, primary_variant {...}`
- Ordered by: `timeline_frame ASC, nullsFirst: false`

export function isVideoGeneration(gen: GenerationRow): boolean {

### Summary Table

| Aspect | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Timeline item count** | All generations with `timeline_frame >= 0`, not video, with valid location |
| **Batch item count** | Same as timeline (uses same filtered `images` array) |
| **Positioned generation** | Any with `timeline_frame IS NOT NULL` and `timeline_frame >= 0` |
| **Type filters** | Videos excluded (type = 'video' or 'video_travel_output' or has .mp4/.webm/.mov extension) |
| **Query function** | `fetchLiveTimeline()` for position data, `useShotImages()` for full generation data |
| **Hooks providing images** | `useTimelineImages()` (timeline mode) or `useShotImages()` filtered via `selectTimelineImages()` |
| **Pair count** | `images.length - 1` for consecutive pairs + 1 if last image has `metadata.end_frame` |
